title: Herb Gardening Indoors in Winter
reason: Provides information on indoor gardening and the benefits of growing herbs.

tasks.task: Discuss the reasons for gardening and the benefits of indoor gardening.

subtasks.text: Mention that there are many reasons why people garden.
Describe how people garden for exercise, as a hobby, and to eat.
Explain that it is possible to get the same satisfaction from gardening indoors as outdoors.

tasks.task: Highlight the best opportunities for indoor gardening during the winter.

subtasks.text: Identify herbs as one of the best plants to grow indoors in the winter.
Note that herbs are hearty and can be used in the kitchen.

tasks.task: Provide tips for growing herbs indoors.

subtasks.text: Mention that herbs do not need to be constantly monitored, but they need care.
Suggest placing herbs where they can receive plenty of light.
Recommend using good soil and avoiding overwatering.
Provide guidance on where to seek further information about herbs and indoor gardening.
